text_en: Ah, soiled, defiled, oppressing city!
text_cn: 祸哉！那叛逆、污秽，而残暴的城市！

text_en: It has listened to no voice; it has accepted no correction. It has not trusted in the Lord ; it has not drawn near to its God.
text_cn: 她从不听呼声，又不接受教训；不倚赖上主，也不亲近她的天主。

text_en: The officials within it are roaring lions; its judges are evening wolves that leave nothing until the morning.
text_cn: 她的王侯在她中间，是些咆哮的狮子；她的判官是夜间的豺狼，什么也不留到天明。

text_en: Its prophets are reckless, faithless persons; its priests have profaned what is sacred, they have done violence to the law.
text_cn: 她的先知都是些轻浮欺诈之徒，她的司祭亵渎圣物，违犯法律。

text_en: The Lord within it is righteous; he does no wrong. Every morning he renders his judgment, each dawn without fail; but the unjust knows no shame.
text_cn: 但上主在她中间是正义的，从不行不义；他每天早晨施行审判，有如不消散的光明，他全不认识可耻的邪恶。

text_en: I have cut off nations; their battlements are in ruins; I have laid waste their streets so that no one walks in them; their cities have been made desolate, without people, without inhabitants.
text_cn: 我曾消灭了异民，他们的堡垒已化为废墟；我使他们的街道荒凉得无人往来，他们的城市毁坏得不留一人，没有一个居民。

text_en: I said, “Surely the city will fear me, it will accept correction; it will not lose sight of all that I have brought upon it. ” But they were the more eager to make all their deeds corrupt.
text_cn: 我原想：“她必要敬畏我，接受教训；凡我加于她的惩罚，必不致由她眼前消失。”但他们反加速使自己的一切行为堕落。

text_en: Therefore wait for me, says the Lord , for the day when I arise as a witness. For my decision is to gather nations, to assemble kingdoms, to pour out upon them my indignation, all the heat of my anger; for in the fire of my passion all the earth shall be consumed.
text_cn: 为此，你们等待我──上主的断语──等到我起来作证的一天，因为我已决定聚集万民，召集列国，在他们身上倾泄我的忿怒和我所有的怒火：全地必要为我的妒火所吞灭。

text_en: At that time I will change the speech of the peoples to a pure speech, that all of them may call on the name of the Lord and serve him with one accord.
text_cn: 那时，我要使万民的口唇纯洁好能称呼上主的名号，同心协力服事上主。

text_en: From beyond the rivers of Ethiopia my suppliants, my scattered ones, shall bring my offering.
text_cn: 钦崇我的人，【即我所分散的集团】要从雇士河那边给我贡献祭品。

text_en: On that day you shall not be put to shame because of all the deeds by which you have rebelled against me; for then I will remove from your midst your proudly exultant ones, and you shall no longer be haughty in my holy mountain.
text_cn: 在那一天，你决不再因你反抗我的一切作为而羞惭，因为那时我必由你中间驱逐你那些骄矜自夸的人，使你不再在我的圣山上自夸；

text_en: For I will leave in the midst of you a people humble and lowly. They shall seek refuge in the name of the Lord —
text_cn: 但我必在你中间留下谦逊和贫苦的百姓，他们必依赖上主的名号。

text_en: the remnant of Israel; they shall do no wrong and utter no lies, nor shall a deceitful tongue be found in their mouths. Then they will pasture and lie down, and no one shall make them afraid.
text_cn: 以色列的遗民不再行邪恶，也不再说谎言；在他们的口里也再找不到欺诈的舌头：的确，他们或是牧放，或是休息，没有人来恐吓。

text_en: Sing aloud, O daughter Zion; shout, O Israel! Rejoice and exult with all your heart, O daughter Jerusalem!
text_cn: 熙雍女子，你应欢乐！以色列，你应欢呼！耶路撒冷女子，你应全心高兴喜乐！

text_en: The Lord has taken away the judgments against you, he has turned away your enemies. The king of Israel, the Lord , is in your midst; you shall fear disaster no more.
text_cn: 上主已撤消了对你的定案，扫除了你的仇敌；以色列的君王──上主，在你中间，你再不会遇见灾祸！

text_en: On that day it shall be said to Jerusalem: Do not fear, O Zion; do not let your hands grow weak.
text_cn: 在那一天，人必对耶路撒冷说：“熙雍，你不用害怕，不要双手低垂！

text_en: The Lord , your God, is in your midst, a warrior who gives victory; he will rejoice over you with gladness, he will renew you in his love; he will exult over you with loud singing
text_cn: 上主你的天主，在你中间，他是一位施救的勇士，他必为你喜不自胜，对你重温他的爱情，且因你欢跃喜乐，

text_en: as on a day of festival. I will remove disaster from you, so that you will not bear reproach for it.
text_cn: 有如在庆节之日。我必消灭打击你的人，使你不再受羞辱。

text_en: I will deal with all your oppressors at that time. And I will save the lame and gather the outcast, and I will change their shame into praise and renown in all the earth.
text_cn: 看啊！在那时，我必要了结一切迫害你的人，我必要拯救瘸腿的，聚集漂流的；我必使他们在各地所受的羞辱，化为称赞和荣誉。

text_en: At that time I will bring you home, at the time when I gather you; for I will make you renowned and praised among all the peoples of the earth, when I restore your fortunes before your eyes, says the Lord .
text_cn: 那时，我必要召你们回来；那时，我必要聚集你们；当我要在你们的面前转变你们的命运时，我必使你们在普世万民中，获得荣誉和称赞──上主说。
